subject.title: fix: show readable session names across Windows UX

question: Should Windows adopt the proposed Gateway presentation contract and hide background session families by default across chat, tray, dashboard, and Sessions UX, with opt-in visibility only on the Sessions page?
rationale: Tests establish mechanics but cannot decide the permanent cross-repository contract or whether removing background sessions from existing navigation is the intended product policy.

options.title: Approve contract and policy
options.body: Accept the additive Gateway schema and proposed visibility behavior, then require current-head WinUI proof before merge.

options.title: Split titles from visibility
options.body: Land readable structured titles while preserving existing visibility, then review background filtering separately.

options.title: Defer Windows consumption
options.body: Wait until the upstream Gateway contract is merged and released before finalizing the Windows parser and UX.

recommendation.title: Approve contract and policy
recommendation.body: Accept the additive Gateway schema and proposed visibility behavior, then require current-head WinUI proof before merge.
